title: King Oliver and Willie playing with the Tuxedo band
summary: She never knew King Oliver; she believes Willie played with all the bands, including Papa Celestin's Tuxedo.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Did you ever know King Oliver by any chance?
No, I've heard talk of him. Joe Oliver, they called him around here.

He's in Chicago, eh? He died. He died during Chicago, yeah. Some place. Some place out there, yeah. I've heard people spoke. I've heard my husband talk about him and all, but for me knowing him, I didn't know him.
I just wondered if your husband ever mentioned playing with various fellows. No.

But I believe my husband played with all of them, to tell the truth. My husband used to play in the Tuxedo Band and all of them. I guess John and them could tell you that. He used to play with any of them, for that's concerned. And then when he had that band, what they played in. Because they used to come get him, you know, he'd go play with any of them. Money wasn't worth money then. Yeah. And then they made good.
Which Tuxedo was that he played with? With Papa Celestan or with John?
Oh, Papa Celestan, he was good buddies. He used to play with all of them. He played with all of them. I don't believe he played with John. No, he was sick when John took that band over, I think.
